changes.before: Your Triple Split Definition is particularly important to the way this chart is integrated. In the current test configuration, the 43–23 Channel connects the Ajna and Throat Centers, the 29–46 Channel connects the Sacral and G Centers, and the 37–40 Channel connects the Solar Plexus and Ego Centers. These form three separate groups rather than one continuously connected defined network. Within the traditional Human Design interpretation, this creates an opportunity to consider how understanding, participation and commitment may develop through different processes.
